description: Opus CC unit B18: Mirror Move calling Sparkling Aria (its onAfterMove, formerly refused for a called move). Setup turn: Primarina's Sparkling Aria hits nothing (Togekiss and Clefable protect, Vaporeon's Water Absorb takes it), so it is Primarina's lastMove. The turn: Togekiss (fastest) uses Mirror Move at Primarina, calling Sparkling Aria from Togekiss; Water Absorb makes Primarina and Vaporeon immune, so the burned Clefable is the one hit target: the secondary gives it the sparklingaria volatile and runMove's AfterMove, which sees the called move, removes it and cures the burn.
